p: SELECT 'promoted: ladder row active, newest cfmb-2 verdict promote, tool-call canary ok' AS expected, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_ladder_models WHERE id = '@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it') THEN 'no ladder row' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_ladder_models WHERE id = '@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it' AND active = 1) THEN 'ladder row active=0' WHEN COALESCE((SELECT verdict FROM cf_model_evals WHERE model_id = '@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it' AND battery_version = 'cfmb-2' ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1), 'none') <> 'promote' THEN 'newest cfmb-2 verdict is not promote' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM routing_capability WHERE model = '@cf/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it' AND tool_call_ok = 1) THEN 'no routing_capability row with tool_call_ok=1' ELSE 'promoted: ladder row active, newest cfmb-2 verdict promote, tool-call canary ok' END AS observed

SELECT 'promoted: ladder row active, newest cfmb-2 verdict promote, tool-call canary ok' AS expected, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_ladder_models WHERE id = '@cf/qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-fp8') THEN 'no ladder row' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_ladder_models WHERE id = '@cf/qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-fp8' AND active = 1) THEN 'ladder row active=0' WHEN COALESCE((SELECT verdict FROM cf_model_evals WHERE model_id = '@cf/qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-fp8' AND battery_version = 'cfmb-2' ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1), 'none') <> 'promote' THEN 'newest cfmb-2 verdict is not promote' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM routing_capability WHERE model = '@cf/qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-fp8' AND tool_call_ok = 1) THEN 'no routing_capability row with tool_call_ok=1' ELSE 'promoted: ladder row active, newest cfmb-2 verdict promote, tool-call canary ok' END AS observed

SELECT 'promoted: ladder row active, newest cfmb-2 verdict promote, tool-call canary ok' AS expected, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_ladder_models WHERE id = '@cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash') THEN 'no ladder row' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_ladder_models WHERE id = '@cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash' AND active = 1) THEN 'ladder row active=0' WHEN COALESCE((SELECT verdict FROM cf_model_evals WHERE model_id = '@cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash' AND battery_version = 'cfmb-2' ORDER BY run_ts DESC LIMIT 1), 'none') <> 'promote' THEN 'newest cfmb-2 verdict is not promote' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM routing_capability WHERE model = '@cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash' AND tool_call_ok = 1) THEN 'no routing_capability row with tool_call_ok=1' ELSE 'promoted: ladder row active, newest cfmb-2 verdict promote, tool-call canary ok' END AS observed

SELECT 'closed' AS expected, CASE WHEN (SELECT status FROM agent_issues WHERE id = 100596) IN ('closed', 'resolved') AND COALESCE((SELECT length(close_evidence) FROM issue_triage WHERE issue_id = 100596), 0) > 20 THEN 'closed' ELSE 'issue 100596 is ' || COALESCE((SELECT status FROM agent_issues WHERE id = 100596), 'missing') || ' without close evidence' END AS observed

SELECT '0' AS expected, CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) AS observed FROM (SELECT body_md, rtrim(substr(body_md, 1, instr(body_md || char(10), char(10)) - 1), char(13)) AS fl, instr(body_md || char(10), char(10)) AS k FROM papers WHERE status = 'published' AND version GLOB '[2-9].*' AND slug NOT IN ('a-unified-framework-for-superdeterminism-neurobiology-and-the-mechanics-of-human-meaning', 'simulation-inconsistency-detection-via-neurobiological-and-cognitive-interfaces')) WHERE ltrim(body_md) LIKE '---%' OR (fl LIKE '# %' AND (instr(substr(body_md, k + 1), char(10) || fl || char(10)) > 0 OR instr(substr(body_md, k + 1), char(10) || fl || char(13)) > 0))

SELECT 'indexed: sitemap lists the published set and an IndexNow engine answered within 7 days' AS expected, CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(last_value AS INTEGER) FROM metric_registry WHERE metric = 'indexed_surface'), 0) < 700 THEN 'indexed_surface below 700' WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CAST(last_value AS INTEGER) FROM metric_registry WHERE metric = 'seo_indexnow_engines_ok'), 0) < 1 THEN 'no IndexNow engine answered' WHEN COALESCE((SELECT last_refreshed FROM metric_registry WHERE metric = 'seo_indexnow_engines_ok'), '') < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '-7 days') THEN 'seo_indexnow_engines_ok older than 7 days' ELSE 'indexed: sitemap lists the published set and an IndexNow engine answered within 7 days' END AS observed

SELECT '2' AS expected, CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) AS observed FROM papers WHERE slug IN ('a-unified-framework-for-superdeterminism-neurobiology-and-the-mechanics-of-human-meaning', 'simulation-inconsistency-detection-via-neurobiological-and-cognitive-interfaces') AND ltrim(body_md) LIKE '# %' AND instr(body_md, '## Abstract') > 0 AND body_md NOT LIKE '%TOPIC COMPLEXITY ASSESSMENT%' AND body_md NOT LIKE '%Here is the continuation of the detailed%'

SELECT 'every reply row older than 60 minutes is tiered and drafted' AS expected, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_reply_queue WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12 12:00:00' AND human_score >= 2 AND tier IN ('1', '2', '3')) < 3 THEN 'unmeasured: fewer than 3 tiered rows' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM email_reply_queue WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12 12:00:00' AND human_score >= 2 AND decision <> 'closed' AND created_at < datetime('now', '-60 minutes') AND NOT COALESCE(tier IN ('1', '2', '3') AND (tier = '1' OR draft_proposed IS NOT NULL), 0)) > 0 THEN 'rows older than 60 minutes are untiered or undrafted' ELSE 'every reply row older than 60 minutes is tiered and drafted' END AS observed

SELECT 'owner decision recorded or credibility event or new confirmed subscriber' AS expected, CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN last_value GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(last_value AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END FROM metric_registry WHERE metric = 'credibility_events_90d'), 0) >= 1 THEN 'owner decision recorded or credibility event or new confirmed subscriber' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscribers WHERE confirmed_at > (SELECT MAX(ts) FROM owner_prompts WHERE id = 'op-mvihv5rr376f')) THEN 'owner decision recorded or credibility event or new confirmed subscriber' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM human_actions WHERE slug = 'attest-first-credibility-event' AND status IN ('dismissed', 'resolved')) THEN 'owner decision recorded or credibility event or new confirmed subscriber' ELSE 'owner step open: no event, no new subscriber, card undecided' END AS observed

SELECT 'skills mirror recorded as unmaintained and its owner worker is retired' AS expected, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decision_log WHERE action LIKE 'CLUSTER-F-B-1000152:%') THEN 'no decision recorded' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_registry WHERE service = 'qnfo-skill-sync' AND COALESCE(state, '') <> 'retired') THEN 'qnfo-skill-sync is live in service_registry' ELSE 'skills mirror recorded as unmaintained and its owner worker is retired' END AS observed
